description: This file defines a Lightning component called 'NotesList' which renders a list of notes with properties such as title, preview, and timestamp. It manages internal state for selected note and note list, with watchers and hooks to update the UI accordingly.

classes.name: NotesList
classes.description: A Lightning component that displays a list of notes with selectable items, styled using theme variables and supporting note previews and selection highlight.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Initializes component state with theme-based colors, empty note list, and selected ID.

methods.name: watch
methods.description: Defines reactive handlers for updates to 'notes' (to populate the list) and 'selectedId'.

methods.name: hooks.ready
methods.description: Component initialization hook to populate the note list when the component is ready.

methods.name: events.click.handler
methods.description: Handles click events to determine which note item was clicked based on Y coordinate and triggers the onSelect callback with the note ID.
